title: The town chooses its detail and sharpness for your device
items: At start-up the walkthrough now reads what your browser and graphics chip offer and runs a check of well under a second, then picks Scene detail and Image sharpness to suit: a capable computer is drawn at High sharpness, a modest one at Balanced detail, and a strong phone or tablet a little sharper than before.
Settings › Performance says what it chose — for example "Your device: standard computer, chosen Full detail at Medium sharpness" — and anything you pick there still overrides it.
A return visit remembers the result and skips the check. Only flora, shadows and sharpness change between devices; the reconstruction itself is the same everywhere.
